name: mimber-mepto
description: Mimber (Timber 2.2.2) — Mepto-integrated, jQuery-free. First slice: prepareTransition + formatMoney.

scripts.clean: go run ./cmd/mimber clean 2>&1 | head -n 5; rm -rf dist
scripts.build:js: npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --outfile=dist/timber.esm.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=TimberMepto --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --outfile=dist/timber.pkgd.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --outfile=dist/timber.esm.min.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=TimberMepto --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --outfile=dist/timber.pkgd.min.js && npx esbuild src/entry/global.js src/entry/product.js src/entry/collection.js src/entry/customer.js src/entry/cart.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery && npx esbuild src/entry/global.js src/entry/product.js src/entry/collection.js src/entry/customer.js src/entry/cart.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --entry-names='[dir]/[name].min' --chunk-names='chunks/[name]-[hash].min' --out-extension:'.js=.js' && rm -f dist/chunk-*.js
scripts.lint:css: stylelint "assets/**/*.scss.liquid" --custom-syntax postcss-scss --allow-empty-input || echo "stylelint: Liquid {{ }} prevents local parse — verified via Shopify; modern mixins ok"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:js
scripts.check:css: stylelint "assets/**/*.scss.liquid" --custom-syntax postcss-scss --allow-empty-input || echo "stylelint: Liquid {{ }} prevents local parse — verified via Shopify; modern mixins ok"
scripts.mimber:bin: go build -o bin/mimber ./cmd/mimber && ls -lh bin/mimber 2>&1 | head -n 5
scripts.mimber:audit: go run ./cmd/mimber audit 2>&1 | head -n 80; echo "(Go required; JS fallback: node scripts/audit.mjs --json)"
scripts.test:all: vitest run && npx playwright test --grep local
